query: Can you do an architecture review of this repo before we start the refactor? It's Next.js with Prisma on Postgres and some pgvector stuff for search.
We have both MongoDB and Postgres in this service and nobody can tell me which one is the source of truth for users. Audit it.
pre-acquisition technical due diligence on packages/api — I need severity-ranked findings I can hand to the board, not a list of lint warnings
Review our shadcn components directory. We've been editing them in place and also wrapping some of them and I think it's a mess.
Design critique of the data layer please. We're on serverless (Vercel) and I'm worried about Prisma connection counts.
Before we migrate off this monolith, tell me what's actually load-bearing in src/ and what's safe to delete. Don't change anything.
Something is wrong with how embeddings get regenerated when documents change. Can you look at the whole lifecycle and tell me where it breaks?
I want a pre-mortem on this checkout flow. Where does it fail in production in a year?
Fix the N+1 query in getOrdersForUser in src/services/orders.ts.
Review this PR diff for bugs before I merge it. It's about 40 lines in the auth middleware.
Write an ADR for choosing Postgres over MongoDB for the new events service.
Refactor components/ui/button.tsx to use cva variants instead of the className ternaries.
Design a system for ingesting 10k documents a day and serving vector search over them. Greenfield, nothing exists yet.
Our Postgres query on the embeddings table is slow. Here's the EXPLAIN ANALYZE output, what index do I need?
Run the tests in packages/api and tell me why the Prisma transaction test is flaky.
Add a Zod schema to the /api/upload route handler.
